items.c: 20 weeks and proteinuria split the three; aspirin 150 mg prevents.
items.a: Chronic hypertension predates 20 weeks; gestational starts at or after 20 weeks without proteinuria; preeclampsia starts at or after 20 weeks with 140 over 90 twice plus protein 300 mg per day or PCR 30, or any severe feature. High-risk women take aspirin 150 mg from 12 to 36 weeks.

items.t: Hypertensive disorders: preeclampsia, eclampsia and HELLP
items.c: Pritchard IM or Zuspan IV; lost reflexes stop the drip.
items.a: Pritchard loads 4 g IV plus 10 g IM then 5 g IM 4-hourly; Zuspan loads 4 g IV then 1 to 2 g per hour. Toxicity climbs from lost reflexes to slow breathing to arrest, reversed by calcium gluconate. Labetalol leads pressure control; ACE inhibitors are banned.
